findings.suggested_fix: Record the marklas upstream repo URL and the exact commit sha in the Scope/AC (e.g. `# vendored from <url>@<sha>`), and have the import test assert that recorded sha.

findings.finding: The plan repoints AdfCodec.to_wire/decode_inbound at Markdown-aware functions but does not enumerate the existing pin test that asserts they equal the plain adf.text_to_adf / adf_to_text — a consumer the change would break.
findings.location: Approach step 1 / Scope: rich_text_codec.py
findings.suggested_fix: Add the pin test to Scope/Testing: replace its `to_wire == text_to_adf` / `decode_inbound == adf_to_text(...)` assertions with pins against the new `markdown_to_adf`/`adf_to_markdown` (keeping the wrapper-not-a-copy intent).

findings.finding: The leaf deliberately changes Cloud's observable rendering (native rich text instead of literal Markdown source), but the parent chain's contract requires Cloud's observable behavior to be UNCHANGED (epic e369 AC6; J1's golden oracles; J3 AC 'J1's pinned Cloud oracles pass with their assertions unmodified').
findings.location: Plan Context/Problem & Acceptance Criteria ('AdfCodec.to_wire emits Markdown-aware ADF (heading/list/code/emphasis nodes, not literal #/-/** text)')

findings.finding: The leaf adds new scope — vendoring marklas under src/rebar/_vendor/marklas/ and recording its sha in pyproject.toml — that neither parent J3 nor epic e369 contains; the epic confines new third-party dependencies to the opt-in [jira-datacenter] extra and its stated seam adds 'no new plumbing.'
findings.location: Plan Approach step 2 & Scope ('src/rebar/_vendor/marklas/ — vendored, sha-pinned upstream copy'; 'pyproject.toml — record the vendored sha')

findings.finding: The plan repoints AdfCodec.to_wire/decode_inbound/normalize_outbound but omits the existing pin tests that structurally reference those methods and assert they equal the plain adf.text_to_adf/adf_to_text/normalize_description — the Scope's tests/ line lists only new tests.
findings.location: Scope bullet 'tests/ — corpus idempotence, mark-order, failure-path, live cutover' and Approach step 1 (repoint AdfCodec.to_wire/decode_inbound/normalize_outbound)
findings.suggested_fix: Run find_referencing_symbols on AdfCodec.to_wire/decode_inbound/normalize_outbound AND grep the string names to catch the pass-through pins, then list each affected test and its intended new assertion.
